description.value: Hops is a neighborhood pub in downtown New Westminster specializing in micro-brews from the Pacific Northwest, with a rotating selection of craft drafts, cocktails, and a full food menu prepared by in-house staff. The pub offers both a cozy indoor space and a summer patio, and is notably dog-friendly, providing water and treats for well-behaved canine companions. Regular events including Sunday cult-classic movie nights, Tuesday trivia, and open game nights make it a lively social hub in the heart of New Westminster.
